subject: [hw] lead -> opus-perf: while you are in n2a32_core.c: propagate a failed nested call out of the host-call path
body: emu/n2a32_core.c run loop, host-call branch: after hf(c) the loop continues unconditionally. If the shim made a nested n2a32_call that failed (qsort comparator, pthread_once routine, thread start), c->stop holds that failure but the outer guest keeps running with a garbage result, and a later UNDEF is mislabelled because of `if (c->stop == N2A32_STOP_NONE) c->stop = UNDEF` (this is the root of R1 F20). Fix: n2a32_call on failure leaves c->stop != NONE (it does); in the host-call branch, right after hf(c): if (c->stop != N2A32_STOP_NONE && c->stop != N2A32_STOP_RETURN) { c->stop_addr stays as set by the failure; break; } and make successful nested calls restore c->stop to NONE (they restore saved_stop, which is NONE inside a run: fine). Also F8: read c->stop_request with __atomic_load_n(&c->stop_request, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) (V32 stores it atomically). Keep test_v02 green and add one test: a host call whose nested call hits UDF stops the outer run with STOP_UNDEF at the inner address.
